# testing_x_match_nested_readonly (Resource)

XMatchNestedReadonly Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_match_nested_readonly" "my_xmatchnestedreadonly" {
  name = "...my_name..."
  safety_settings = {
    enforce_approval = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `safety_settings` (Attributes) Response-only container for safety settings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--safety_settings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--safety_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `safety_settings`

Optional:

- `enforce_approval` (Boolean) Approval enforcement setting

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Response-only timestamp

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_match_nested_readonly.my_testing_x_match_nested_readonly
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_match_nested_readonly.my_testing_x_match_nested_readonly "..."
```
